name: AIDE (ICLR 2025) progan_train
limitations: Checkpoint is not committed; run scripts/fetch_aide.py to download progan_train.pth (~3.3 GB, research license).

Measured locally (2026-09): JPEG recompression collapses fake scores (DALL-E 91->6 at q50) and real-image false positives alike (Lenna 85->12 at q75) — below q75 this member is auto down-weighted via 'degraded_weight'. See experiments/RECOMPRESSION_EVAL.md.
AIDE scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label; see experiments/AIDE_EVALUATION.md for measured AUROC and cross-generator caveats.
notes: Runtime 'aide' delegates to scripts/run_aide.py, which bakes AIDE's DCT band-selection preprocessing into the model class; input_size/mean/std are recorded for reference rather than consumed by the generic image preprocessor.
Model logits are (real=0, fake=1); score_index 1 with softmax yields the fake probability on a 0-100 scale.
The checkpoint path is relative to this profile's directory (models/); keep it out of git — it is covered by .gitignore.
